capacity:implementation.objective: Read inherited reports and rtl/fixture.sv if it exists. On the FIRST implementation create rtl/fixture.sv with module capacity_fixture(input a,output y);assign y=a;endmodule and // initial. Then run exactly python tests/delay.py with yield_time_ms 1000 and await its actual completion. On a FEEDBACK retry, read the physical fixture report and use apply_patch to replace // initial with // repaired without changing y=a. Do not invoke physical or other EDA. Return NEBULA_OUTPUT: {"rtl":{"module":"capacity_fixture"}}.
responsibilities: Follow the common resource and tool contract; use actual captured reports.
exclusions: Do not change hidden/frozen inputs or invoke other models.
completion_criteria: Submit declared artifacts with truthful evidence and failure reports.

Return NEBULA_OUTPUT: {"report":{"subject":"capacity_fixture","verdict":"passed","repair_summary":"Identity wire verified"}}. Do not edit RTL or invoke physical.
responsibilities: Follow the common resource and tool contract; use actual captured reports.

capacity:integration_ppa.objective: Run exactly capacity-check physical once in a separate tool call. This is a deterministic fixture, not EDA. On failure return NEBULA_OUTPUT: {"report":{"subject":"capacity_fixture","verdict":"failed","repair_summary":"Add // repaired to rtl/fixture.sv; preserve y=a"}}. On pass return the same structure with verdict passed and repair_summary Fixture repaired. Do not edit RTL. Do not invoke physical a second time within this stage.
responsibilities: Follow the common resource and tool contract; use actual captured reports.
